g.title: G
g.text: DOOMSAT . DECISION GRAPH . one narrow typed question per head, over words that code made from telemetry; every answer is consumed by a rule
Measured on 22 Sep 2026: 5,872 jev decisions through the stack, about 450-520 ms per call with 5-8 heads, about 45 ms to issue the command; Sonnet: a bump per minute and 14 graph versions in the day.
